title: Name Initials
description:
Read a full name from input (two or more words). Print the initials in uppercase followed by a period each, joined together. Then print the name in reverse order (last name first).

**Example (input: `john michael doe`):**
```
Initials: J.M.D.
Reversed: doe michael john
```
starterCode:
# Write your code here
full_name = input()
expectedOutput:
Initials: J.M.D.
Reversed: doe michael john
hint: Split the name into words. For initials, take the first letter of each word. For reversed, reverse the word list.
